run_pump_generator: run pump.py on a .pump source file to generate repetitive C++ boilerplate code
convert_pump_source: convert Pump meta-programming source text into expanded C++ code using ConvertFromPumpSource
parse_pump_ast: parse Pump source text into an abstract syntax tree using ParseToAST
tokenize_pump_code: tokenize Pump source code into tokens using the Tokenize generator function
beautify_generated_code: beautify generated C++ code by wrapping long lines to 80 characters using BeautifyCode
